title: The square function estimate for the cone in four dimensions
summary: We obtain the $L^3$ reverse square function estimate for the light cone in four dimensions from the critical local-smoothing and round-cone propagation statements in the September 2026 OpenAI manuscript. We state these inputs, together with the plate maximal theorem of Di Plinio and Parissis, in a preliminaries section. The proof passes from geometric concentration of packet coefficients to regularity of the analyzed wave, and then from free waves to arbitrary functions supported near the cone.
